<!--
Thanks for contributing to prismalens! The trunk (`main`) is protected: every
change lands via a pull request. Open this PR against `main`.
Keep PRs focused and small where you can.
-->

## What & why

<!-- What does this change do, and what problem does it solve? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / internal
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Build / CI / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] PR is opened against `main`
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...) — it
      becomes the squashed commit subject
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm format-and-lint`
      pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private content committed
- [ ] Every issue this PR finishes, except an umbrella, has its own `closes #n`; `closingIssuesReferences` on the PR lists them
- [ ] Breaking config or schema change → called out above

## Docs

- [ ] Changes the documented contract ([docs/POLICY.md](https://github.com/prismalens/prismalens.io/blob/main/docs/POLICY.md)): website PR or docs issue linked below. Otherwise nothing to do.

## Related issues

<!--
One keyword per issue: `closes #1, closes #2`. `Closes #1, #2` links only #1.
Closing keywords fire only when the PR merges into `main`. A PR that finishes
only part of an issue writes `refs #n` and the issue stays open. Do not write
`closes #n` for an umbrella; it is closed by hand when its Done when is met.
-->
